subject: Accelerator cohort: top-up credits & trial extension request
messages:
From: Nathalie Ortiz <nathalie@seedbridge.org>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator ask - cohort top-up credits & trial extension

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders loved the latency numbers and the simplified rollout story. Two asks from our program team that came up in the follow-up:

- For our Spring cohort (25 early-stage startups) we were hoping Redwood could offer an additional top-up of credits on top of the standard startup package. Suggested amount: $3,000 in credits per company.
- A 45-day extension to the standard trial window for cohort startups (many are product-ready but need time to onboard several engineers).

This is a one-off request tied to the SeedBridge Spring cohort. If there's an approval path or a standard promo we should be using, point me there and we can move quickly — we have companies kicking off next week.

Attached: cohort-list.csv (names + company emails). Procurement may follow up for an SOW.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

— Nathalie
Nathalie Ortiz
Program Director, SeedBridge Accelerator
Nathalie@seedbridge.org

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood-inference.com>
To: Nathalie Ortiz <nathalie@seedbridge.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator ask - cohort top-up credits & trial extension

Hi Nathalie — thanks for the note and the cohort list.

Quick answers up front: we have an internal framework for accelerator partnerships, but requests for bulk top-ups + trial extensions usually need a one-time approval from Sales Ops and Finance. I can push this through but need to confirm a few constraints.

To set expectations:
- Standard startup package: $5k credits for 90 days (self-serve).
- We can consider a one-time top-up; approvals depend on total exposure and whether startups are eligible for our founders/officer program.
- Trial extensions beyond 90 days are exceptional — we typically offer shorter extensions (30 days) unless paired with a promotional credit commitment.

If it helps, I attached an incubator-pricing-draft.pdf that outlines a couple of structured options we commonly use:
A) Cohort top-up: $3k credit per startup, validity 60 days, with a 10% first-invoice credit if they convert to paid within 90 days.
B) Extension-first: 45-day trial extension for 10 selected companies (need names), no credits.

Can you confirm which of these you'd prefer (A or B), and whether procurement needs an SOW up front? If you want, let's set a 30-minute call this afternoon.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood-inference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Accelerator ask - cohort top-up credits & trial extension

Sergio — forwarding the thread and my quick ops take.

Notes from Pricing/Finance:
- Total exposure if we do $3k x 25 = $75k in credits. Finance will approve on a case-by-case basis; they will expect a cohort conversion target (we usually ask for a 20% conversion to paid within 90 days as a baseline).
- We can do the 60-day credit validity (option A in your draft) as a compromise — it limits long tail exposure.
- Trial extension to 45 days is tougher without a nominal credit attached; recommend 30 days + optional top-up for late onboarders.

Attachments: pricing-sheet.xlsx (rollup of historical accelerator deals + suggested thresholds).

If you want approval language I can draft an internal one-pager for Finance to sign off. From a go/no-go perspective: Finance will sign if we (a) cap validity at 60 days, (b) collect a short cohort conversion commitment, and (c) get procurement to accept a simple SOW.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Partnerships / Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood-inference.com>
To: Nathalie Ortiz <nathalie@seedbridge.org>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@incuvate.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator ask - cohort top-up credits & trial extension

Nathalie/Tom — thanks for the patience. I went through the ask with Sales Ops and Finance and we can offer a one-time, limited exception for the Spring cohort with the following terms:

Summary of approved offer (one-time exception):
- Top-up credits: $3,000 in platform credits per startup for up to 25 companies (total exposure capped at $75,000).
- Credit validity: 60 days from issuance.
- Trial extension: 30-day trial extension for all cohort members (applied automatically), with additional 30 days on a case-by-case basis for startups that request the top-up and complete onboarding within the first 14 days.
- Conversion incentive: 10% credit applied to the first invoice if a startup converts to a paid plan within 90 days.

Requirements / next steps:
1) SeedBridge to confirm the list of companies that will receive top-ups (use cohort-list.csv) and indicate which 10, if any, should be prioritized for earlier issuance.
2) Procurement: we need a short SOW signed. I've attached SOW_v2.pdf and will route via DocuSign.
3) Finance asks for the cohort conversion target in the SOW; suggest we list a target of 20% conversion to paid within 90 days as a mutual KPI.

DocuSign link for the SOW (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/receiver?token=EXAMPLE-DS-12345

If that aligns with SeedBridge, I'll issue the credits and cc your program ops on the redemption workflow. Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to finalize details.

Best regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood-inference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments referenced: SOW_v2.pdf (short-form SOW), pricing-sheet.xlsx (from Sales Ops).
